blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Katrina Anne Johnson combines Filipino and Japanese cultures in “Buklod,” her official national costume for Miss International 2026. The national costume pays tribute to seven decades of friendship between the Philippines and Japan. Buklod means “unite” and celebrates the distinct cultural identities of both countries while highlighting the longstanding relationship nurtured […]...
